zh.discover.stats: 本站汇集AGI会员的代表性设计作品，以瀑布流方式向公众呈现当代平面设计的多元面貌，涵盖品牌、海报、书籍、字体、包装、导视等多个领域。共{total}个项目 · {designers}位设计师 · 覆盖{countries}个国家 · 创作跨度{span}年。数据来源于AGI（国际平面设计联盟）官方公开资料，所有作品版权归原作者及设计师所有，仅供学习交流使用，不得用于商业用途。

zh.about.intro.title: 项目简介
zh.about.intro.p1: AGI（Alliance Graphique Internationale，国际平面设计联盟）成立于1951年，由全球顶尖平面设计师组成，致力于推动平面设计专业的国际交流与学术发展。
zh.about.usage.title: 浏览说明
zh.about.usage.search.title: 搜索
zh.about.usage.search.text: ：支持标题、设计师、客户、标签等关键词；可叠加年份、国家、类型筛选。
zh.about.usage.index.title: 索引
zh.about.usage.index.text: ：按国家、类型、领域、设计师A-Z四类索引浏览；点击任一项查看对应作品。点Logo可回到全部作品。
zh.about.usage.fav.title: 收藏
zh.about.usage.fav.text: ：灯箱左上角 ♥ 收藏作品，收藏保存在浏览器本地，换设备不同步。
zh.about.usage.theme.title: 主题/手势
zh.about.usage.theme.text: ：点击右上角汉堡打开药丸菜单，点太阳/月亮图标切换主题，灯箱内支持双指缩放、双击放大后可拖动。

en.about.intro.title: About
en.about.intro.p1: AGI (Alliance Graphique Internationale) was founded in 1951 and brings together the world's leading graphic designers, promoting international exchange and academic development of the graphic design profession.
en.about.usage.title: Browsing guide
en.about.usage.search.title: Search
en.about.usage.search.text: : supports title, designer, client, tags and more; can combine with year, country, type filters.
en.about.usage.index.title: Index
en.about.usage.index.text: : browse by country, type, sector, or designer A-Z; tap any item to return to the homepage filtered. Tap the logo to return to all works.
en.about.usage.fav.title: Favorites
en.about.usage.fav.text: : tap ♥ in the lightbox to save. Favorites are stored locally in the browser (localStorage) and won't sync across devices.
en.about.usage.theme.title: Theme/Gestures
en.about.usage.theme.text: : open the pill menu via the hamburger, then tap the sun / moon icon to switch theme. In the lightbox, pinch to zoom, double-tap to zoom in, and drag when zoomed.
en.about.stats: This site gathers representative works by AGI members, presenting the diversity of contemporary graphic design through a masonry layout, covering branding, posters, books, typography, packaging, wayfinding and more. {total} projects · {designers} designers · {countries} countries · span {span}. Data is sourced from the official AGI (Alliance Graphique Internationale) public materials. All works are copyrighted by their respective authors and designers, and are provided for study and exchange purposes only, not for commercial use.
